report:
Reviewed the complete exact_comparison claim, its ordinary implementation in sage-oracle-harness/src/lib.rs, its explicit TODO implementation in tests/independent_coverage.rs, its two associated tests, and captured supporting schema/emitter/fixture-runner context. Requirements are: independent Sage and rustc emissions in the shared schema; complete independently validated values; deterministic serialization; equality decided exclusively by serialized byte identity; optional diffing used only to diagnose inequality.

The implemented comparison boundary is sound. assert_crates_eq takes two Crate<NormalizedDef> values and independently serializes each with serde_json::to_string_pretty, without sorting, renumbering, reparsing, or normalizing them before comparison. assert_serialized_text_eq returns Ok only when the Rust strings are equal, which is equality of their UTF-8 bytes. For unequal strings it parses JSON solely to generate diagnostics: both the structurally equal branch and structural-difference branch return Err. Thus diagnostic equality cannot override a byte mismatch. JSON parsing unwraps are consistent with its private production caller supplying serialized schema values; this helper is not an arbitrary untrusted-text comparison API. The single-file and directory Fixture entry points invoke distinct Sage and rustc paths and return the same typed schema. Captured rust-ref declarations establish the shared serialized representation; captured Sage and oracle entry points establish the separate producer boundaries. These are supporting context, not a new claim that all emitter semantics are complete.

The ordinary exact_text_is_the_conformance_boundary test explicitly accepts identical pretty-printed bytes, rejects whitespace-distinct but structurally identical JSON, and asserts the diagnostic for that case. It would detect replacing the equality decision with structural JSON equality. The other associated test is explicitly TODO, not passing behavioral coverage: it defers independent perturbations, more byte-difference cases, ordering of diagnostic execution, and reviewed snapshots for pinned slices until that complete evidence is associated and reviewed. Its empty body is not counted as verification. Source inspection establishes the structural-difference branch unconditionally rejects, but this review does not represent the existing ordinary test as exhaustive coverage of all byte differences.

The complete-value validation clause remains a prerequisite, not an accomplished consequence of byte equality. Captured independent_coverage.rs explicitly documents the already-deferred generic per-emitter source item/body inventories and shared validator rejecting unsupported/debug placeholders; its eligible TODO requires those components before enabling the ignored paired-unsupported-body regression and adding omission/debug-fallback cases. The captured run_fixture segment confirms fixture-specific checks for three named slices before exact comparison, rather than a generic validator. This existing explicit architectural deferral adequately accounts for the overlapping completeness requirement here; accepting the comparator evidence does not certify arbitrary fixtures as fully covered. At the coordinator's request, this existing implementation TODO now also carries the exact_comparison association so its missing validation prerequisite is visible directly in this anchor's generated status. The ordinary byte comparator remains ordinary; no implemented behavior was reclassified. Determinism is likewise producer-owned: the comparator preserves supplied ordering and serializes directly, while the associated TODO retains broader end-to-end evidence work. The report approves the current implemented exact-byte boundary and honestly preserves those existing deferrals, not the full destination as implemented.

Executed review start with the coordinator instruction file and review read commands to capture all supporting source consulted. The only source edit was the coordinated extra exact_comparison marker on the existing implementation TODO. Ran cargo fmt, restarted this review, inspected the fresh complete association set, and recaptured supporting dependencies. No behavioral tests were executed by this reviewer; root owns centralized build, test execution, and required delegated quality checks. Two out-of-bounds read attempts failed before capture and were retried with valid ranges/whole-file selection. No new behavioral defect is alleged, and no regression reproduction is claimed. All ordinary and TODO entries are accounted for; no requested source edits are needed.
